'''Trista Zel''' was an [[Police officer/Legends|officer]] in [[Hapan Security]] in [[41 ABY]]. Trista was five minutes older than her identical [[Twin/Legends|twin]] sister [[Taryn Zel]] and the first cousin of [[Queen Mother]] [[Tenel Ka Djo]]. She and her sister were almost identical in appearance to their cousin, Tenel Ka.

==Biography==
===Early life===
Taryn and Trista were born to a [[Gender/Legends|male]] sibling of [[Isolder]] sometime around [[20 ABY/Legends|20 ABY]].<ref name="age" /> When they reached adulthood, Taryn and Trista became [[Police officer/Legends|officers]] in [[Hapan Security]], and due to their close relations with Tenel Ka, were very useful operatives to her. Nobody knew of their close relationship to Tenel Ka, and they were given their own security team to help them out during missions.

===Retrieving Ben===
Trista and her sister were tasked by Tenel Ka and [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Isolder]] to retrieve [[Ben Skywalker]] and return him to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] base on [[Shedu Maad]]. However, on the way to meet up with Isolder at the rendezvous point, Isolder's ship came under attack by the [[Anakin Solo (starship)|''Anakin Solo'']], and the prince was captured. The twins then took Ben directly to Tenel Ka to inform her of her father's capture.

Later on, the twins and Ben Skywalker were assigned to defend Shedu Maad against an attack by the ''Anakin Solo''. The pair were shocked to hear that a [[Nanovirus|nanokiller]] had been released on the ''[[Dragon Queen]]'', killing all those on board with royal blood, and refused to answer Ben's questions as to whether or not Tenel Ka and [[Allana Djo Solo|Allana]] were among the casualties. Shortly after, the twins and Ben uncovered a plot by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Livette]] to betray the Hapan crown by allying with the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Remnant]]. Trista volunteered to stay behind and keep an eye on the traitor. She ordered Taryn and Ben to go after the Remnant troops and their leader, [[Tahiri Veila]].

Afterwards, during the [[Evacuation of Ossus (Lost Tribe of Sith emergence)|evacuation]] of the [[New Jedi Order]] from the [[Jedi Academy (Ossus)|Jedi Academy]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]], she helped evacuate the students and their families before an attack by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
